#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
export GENOS_PATCH_DEV="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${GENOS_DEV:-$HOME/DEV}}"
task_logs="$GENOS_PATCH_DEV/TRANSFER/urllib-tls-r1/bootstrap-logs"
if ! mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; then task_logs="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-focused-rules-$(id -u)"; mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; fi
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
trap 'task_exit=$?; printf "URLLIB_TLS_EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n" "$task_exit" "$task_log"; printf "%s\n" "$task_exit" > "$task_log.exit"' EXIT
printf 'URLLIB_TLS_LOG=%s\n' "$task_log"
if [[ -n "${GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:-}" ]]; then export PATH="$GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:$PATH"; elif [[ -x /venv/bin/python3 ]]; then export PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"; fi
if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then set -- apply; fi
python3 - "$@" <<'URLLIB_TLS_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys,types,zlib
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='68f25e404968142a8925ae6947dd96c57fd8e332ad80cd8cca1329898fc4068a'
bundle=json.loads(raw);module=types.ModuleType('urllib_tls_installer')
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(bundle['code']),'apply_patch.py','exec'),module.__dict__)
raise SystemExit(module.main(bundle['spec'],['--root',os.environ['GENOS_PATCH_DEV'],*sys.argv[1:]]))
URLLIB_TLS_PY
